messages.subject: Larkmoor - Series C completion checklist
messages.plaintextBody:
James - separately from Falcon, can you pick up the completion checklist on the Larkmoor Bioscience Series C financing? Marisdale's counsel want the conditions list back by Friday. Nothing to do with Verdant - just flagging it landed in my inbox and you're the obvious person.

Sarah
